The man and woman both had formidable presences; they were Eighth Rank Evolvers.

The man was tall, with pupils of a sky-blue color, obviously of extraordinary bloodline.

The woman wore a light white robe, exuding a profound air, with silver patterns faintly visible on her forehead.

“This planet was originally a strategic planet of the Shadow Tribe, controlling this star domain from here. But now, it has become the main star of our Human Civilization.”

The male Evolver exclaimed in admiration.

...

“To be precise, it’s the main star of the Milky Way Star Region. That Galaxy Master, with his immense wealth, directly upgraded this planet to a Grade B Planet.”

The female Evolver said with a smile.

It was a well-known fact that the Galaxy Master was fabulously wealthy—after all, one hundred thousand cubic universe crystals was no small sum, a peak of the Eighth Rank Evolver could not amass it.

If Lin Yuan wasn’t a top genius of Human Civilization, an Eighth Rank Evolver below the age of one hundred, it wouldn’t be possible for him to have more than one hundred thousand cubic universe crystals even with the celebration of advancing to the Eighth Rank.

Those major powers and Lone Evolvers were not foolish,

If Lin Yuan were just an ordinary Evolver, they probably wouldn’t even celebrate,

Even out of respect for the Chikun Star Lord, at most they would give a token gesture.

How could they possibly bleed wealth in their gifts?

“This Galaxy Master is indeed extraordinary, not only in his financial strength but also in power. Shortly after taking office, he purged this star domain of special life forms and Alien Lone Walkers, staining his hands with the blood of at least six or seven members of the Eighth Rank Alien Race…”

Speaking to this point, the male Evolver’s face showed some hesitation, “I don’t know if he would be willing to accept our allegiance…”

“Besides, this Galaxy Master is very young, not yet a hundred years old. If the two of us take the initiative to follow him…”

The male Evolver voiced his true thoughts.

In the Ten Thousand Races of the Cosmic Starry Sky, it’s quite normal for the weak to follow the strong.

But both of them were several tens of thousands of years old, to follow a ‘youngster’ who was not yet a hundred years old?

In the Human Civilization Alliance, or even among other groups, once a decision to follow is made, one is completely bound to the leader.

No matter what happens in the future, the connection can’t be cut.

“Lu Ran, you care too much about face, and thus you miss out on opportunities,” the female Evolver beside him shook her head slightly, “The Galaxy Master is too young right now, which makes it the perfect time for us to follow him. Otherwise, with the Galaxy Master’s cultivation speed, by the time he’s a few thousand or tens of thousands of years old, invincible at the Eighth Rank? Or even a Ninth Rank Evolver, by then, he probably won’t accept followers.”

“By following him now, while others are still hesitant, we’ll not only gain benefits but will at least have a higher status than those who follow later.”

The female Evolver thought comprehensively.

Face? Only the weak care about their face.

“You’re right.”

The male Evolver nodded slightly upon hearing this.

He knew well the difference between offering timely aid and adding flowers to the brocade.

Now the Galaxy Master had just newly advanced to the Eighth Rank and had just taken over a star domain; their following him at this time could actually be of help.

It was somewhat like providing timely help during a crisis.

“By becoming followers, we must obey the Galaxy Master’s orders, otherwise, even if the Galaxy Master kills us, the three Goddesses will not intervene.”

The male Evolver stated.

“To obtain something, one must give something. It’s delusional to expect benefits without risks…”

The female Evolver headed straight toward the Milky Way Main Star.

Seeing this, the male Evolver immediately followed.

The two rapidly descended onto the Star Platform of the Milky Way Main Star.

Boom, boom, boom.

The Planetary Defense System of the Milky Way Main Star emitted vast fluctuations, enveloping them.

A Grade B Planet’s defense system was enough to suppress most Eighth Layer powerhouses in an instant.

“You two Eighth Rank members, what brings you here?” An alien with dark red skin flew out.

He examined them cautiously.

“Eighth Rank?”

The two Eighth Rank man and woman were shocked internally; they had originally thought they would be the first to follow the Galaxy Master.

To their surprise, there were already other Eighth Rank individuals who had followed, and this member was from a Different Species?

“We’ve long heard of the great reputation of the Galaxy Master, and we’ve come specifically to pay him a visit,” the female Eighth Ranker immediately declared their intent.

“A visit to the Star Lord? The two of you?”

After pondering for a moment, the red-skinned alien said, “I’ll go inquire with the Star Lord.”

To request an audience with the Star Lord required the consent of the Star Lord himself; the red-skinned alien was not in a position to decide.

A moment later,

Looking at the two, Hongpi nodded and said, “The Star Lord has agreed. Follow me.”

Shortly after,

The male and female Evolvers entered the palace.

Lin Yuan was clad in green Eighth Rank armor, sitting cross-legged, engrossed in pondering the Space Rule Model. Upon their entrance, he slowly opened his eyes.

Whirr.

It was as if the rising sun had appeared.

Lu Ran and Ruan Wei felt a dryness in their mouths and immediately said with utmost respect, “We’ve come to see the Galaxy Master.”

“Lu Ran, Ruan Wei.” Lin Yuan spoke calmly. All Eighth Rank Evolvers from the Human Civilization Alliance were registered, and with Lin Yuan’s memory, he naturally remembered them clearly.

The pair before him had stepped into the Eighth Rank several thousand years ago. After fulfilling their ‘duty’ of guarding a star domain, they had actively relinquished their roles to journey through the universe.

Guarding a star domain and becoming a Star Lord was certainly a ‘lucrative’ role, but it was also like being confined within drawn boundaries.

A Star Lord must remain in their star domain, or have an Avatar or the original body guarding it.

They could not leave, which some Evolvers found hard to accept, so they do not always remain as Star Lords.

“We’ve heard that the Galaxy Master, by his own hand, cleared the star domain of all unruly Different Species, and we admire that, hence we have come specially to follow.”
